content: LLMs show measurable inconsistency generating code comments/literals in a target non-English language, often defaulting to English or mixing languages within the same code block even when explicitly instructed to write comments in another language - function/variable names in English partially pull the model back toward English lexicon even for comments. No hard technical guardrail exists in the model itself; mitigation is prompt-level (explicit per-field language instructions, e.g. 'code identifiers in English, comments in Russian') plus a post-generation validation/linter pass checking comment language, since instruction alone is not reliably followed 100% of the time.
